The '''Obinipor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obinipor]].<ref name="ws">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
